# EU TED Notices — EU TED Tenders

> Scrape EU public procurement notices from the official TED Search API v3 into flat JSON. Anonymous search, no API key.

## Use it
- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/publicrecords~eu-ted-notices-scraper/runs

## Claims you can rely on
- official TED Search API v3
- anonymous search, no API key
- flat JSON notice records
- keyword, date, notice-type, CPV, and buyer-country filters
- HTML/PDF/XML publication links
